description: An SEO metadata spec defines the per-content-type SEO rules: title templates, meta description constraints, OG image dimensions, robots directives, and hreflang — enforced before any page can go live.

rules.description: An seo-metadata-spec.spec.json must exist with a non-empty contentTypes array where each entry has a typeId.
Every content type must have a titleTemplate. Without it, SEO titles are hardcoded or blank across all pages of that type.
titleMaxLength must be declared and between 50 and 60 characters. Outside this range, titles are truncated in SERPs or waste keyword space.
metaDescriptionMaxLength must be declared and between 120 and 155 characters. Outside this range, descriptions are truncated or too short to drive click-through.
ogImage must declare minWidth >= 1200 and minHeight >= 630. Below this, Open Graph images are rejected or downsampled by social platforms.
robotsDirective must be one of: index,follow | index,nofollow | noindex,follow | noindex,nofollow. No other values are valid for meta robots.
Localized content types must declare hreflang for every locale in spec.locales. Missing hreflang for a locale causes duplicate content issues between language editions.
